summary: Iteration 8: Kebutuhan Assy VS. Stock Part Production Excel grid + Stock Part Production inline cell edit. Backend pytest 44/45 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter8_needs_grid.py; run with -n 0 because module-scoped seed fixture conflicts with xdist). Verified: GET /api/needs-grid returns one row per Master Item (count == items count), all required fields, id 'ics|type', no _id, bad dates -> 400; ACT STOCK = SHIFT 3 TOTAL only (SHIFT 1/2 records NOT added), null when no stock (balance/status_part null); PATCH /api/smt-stock/{id}/cell updates total + indikator and needs-grid act_stock reflects immediately; validation 400 for total/lane/'12a'/1.5/-1, ''->null, 404 unknown id; PATCH /api/needs-grid/cell upsert (3 PATCHes -> 1 doc), audit UPDATE production_needs created, invalid field/value -> 400, unknown ics/type -> 404, STATUS MESIN independent per shift + case-insensitive; BALANCE Sx formula; STATUS PART acceptance with min0/max20 (MID10): bal 0/-1 SHORTAGE, 1 & 10 POTENSI, 11 TIDAK; BALANCE formula incl. actual S3/S1/S2; changing master min/max reflects immediately, 'STD BELUM DISET' when std removed, data not mixed between 2 items; assy user 200 on GET, 403 on both PATCH; regression GETs (dashboard, items, audit, smt-stock, smt-production, production-needs, variance, meta, backup/export) 200. FAILED: string value '1.5' accepted and stored as 15. Frontend (Playwright): 27 headers in exact order + group header row; date input, filters, search, status counts, Export (download kebutuhan-assy-2030-02-01.csv), Muat ulang OK; click+type+Enter saves & moves to next row same column; Tab moves to next editable (plan_customer->plan_s3->actual_s3); arrows navigate without editing; Esc cancels; non-numeric rejected with toast; F2/double-click edit; blur saves; Delete clears; values & STATUS MESIN persist after reload; STATUS PART colored (emerald/amber); master columns not editable; route-intercepted 500 -> cell red + 'Gagal menyimpan (1)' + Coba lagi, after unroute retry succeeds and value persists. /smt-stock: green editable headers GROUP1-6/PART RAGU-RAGU, typing 10+Enter updates TOTAL 40->50 with only a PATCH request (no full reload); Tambah/Edit/Delete/Import dialogs open. assy UI: 'Mode lihat saja', no editors, no Tambah. Dashboard/Master Item/Audit/Backup pages load. BUG: STATUS MESIN dropdown clipped when grid has few rows (search/filter result or bottom rows).

minor.issue: parse_int_cell does str(v).replace('.', '') so string '1.5' becomes 15 and '1.2.3' becomes 123 (silently stored, 200). Spec requires decimals -> 400. JSON number 1.5 correctly -> 400. UI blocks '.' so only API/other clients affected.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown is absolute inside the overflow-auto scroll container (max-h-[68vh]) and opens downward. When the grid has only a few rows (e.g. after search 'ZT UI' -> 2 rows) or the cell is in the last rows, options OFF/DANDORI/(kosong) fall outside the visible area / under the sticky TOTAL tfoot and cannot be clicked with mouse (clicking outside blurs and closes without saving). Works with full 620-row grid on row 0, and keyboard ArrowDown+Enter works. Fix: render the menu in a portal (e.g. shadcn Popover/DropdownMenu) or flip upward when near bottom.

issues: Date filters use native <input type=date> (browser picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover.
GROUP 1..6 / PART RAGU-RAGU headers still green (editable color) although the grid is read-only - slightly misleading.
SMTStock.jsx today() uses UTC toISOString (default form date can be yesterday before 07:00 WIB); ProductionNeeds uses localToday correctly.

action_items: Fix parse_int_cell: reject strings containing '.' or ',' (or only strip thousands separators when the pattern is \d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+) so '1.5' -> 400.
Fix STATUS MESIN dropdown clipping in ExcelGrid (portal-based popover or flip upward near bottom/when few rows).
Optional: replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar; neutral header color for inline columns when not writable; use local date in SMTStock today().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1592 lines - should be split into routers (auth, crud, needs_grid, dashboard, import, backup).
needs_grid loads all items + all needs_entries + all SHIFT 3 stock per request (fine for 618 items) - add index on smt_stock (date, shift, ics_no, type).
shift3_stock_map: if multiple SHIFT 3 records exist for same date/ics/type (possible via force=True duplicates) the last updated wins silently.
needs_grid_cell does find_one existing + find_one_and_update separately; audit 'before' value may be stale under concurrent edits (minor).
PUT /api/items/{id} normalizes the whole body - partial PUT (e.g. only std_stock_min/max) wipes other fields; clients must send the full item.
Rows for needs_entries without a master item are appended (master_found false) and non-editable in UI - OK, but they can never be cleaned through UI.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass except mouse selection of STATUS MESIN option when grid has few rows)

seed_data_creation: Temporary ZT items (9900000081/82, 9900000091/92), smt_stock SHIFT 1/2/3 records (2030-01-15, 2030-02-01) and needs_entries were created and ALL deleted. Verified after cleanup: items=618, smt_stock=0, needs_entries=0, no ZT items. Audit log entries from tests remain (audit trail).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend test with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_needs_grid.py -n 0 (fixture self-seeds & cleans). UI seed: python /app/tests/seed_iter8_ui.py seed|clean (date 2030-02-01, search 'ZT UI'). Playwright page.route glob '**/api/needs-grid/cell' did NOT intercept; use re.compile(r'.*/api/needs-grid/cell.*'). Re-verify: '1.5' string -> 400 and STATUS MESIN option click with 2-row filtered grid.
rca of the issue: 1) parse_int_cell strips all '.' before isdigit() (meant for Indonesian thousand separator), turning decimals into large integers. 2) SelectEditor is rendered with position:absolute top-full inside the td, inside a scroll container with overflow:auto; the container clips it and the sticky tfoot (z-4) overlaps it, so lower options are not hittable when the table is short.
